records.subject: Welcome aboard, Cedar Logistics
records.body:

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, zero activity: no first project, no invite, no milestone, no tickets. Admin never replied to the welcome email [email:7083c956], so there is no engagement signal at all; accounts silent through day 6 rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting Cedar Logistics' first project started
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Checking in on your first week with Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating one real project is the best first step — the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything about how your team works day to day.

Best,
Chidi
